facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 60°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations between 16 days earlier and 5 days later this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Thunder Basin
evidence.detail: left May 7; earlier seasons: May 24 (2023), May 23 (2024), May 18 (2025)

evidence.name: Swamp Creek
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: May 6 (2023), April 13 (2024), April 14 (2025)

evidence.name: Park Creek Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: May 21 (2023), May 18 (2024), May 20 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the second highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Swamp Creek (3,930 ft), the third highest at Thunder Basin (4,310 ft) and the lowest at Park Creek Ridge (4,610 ft).

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 20 and May 18, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.
